_doc: Age shapes practised skills (systems/practiceSkills.js: learnMult, ageShift, level vs trainedLevel). The young learn faster; the body's skills fade after onset (XP kept: the effective level falls, perks read it); the mind's trades keep learning and, seasoned, gain a level. A holder's age: holder.age (player, walking NPC), else holder.skillAge (stamped by seedNpc/growNpc); none known → prime, no change.

milestones.title: Your Years: 25
milestones.text: The quick learning of youth is behind you: skills come at a steady pace now.

milestones.title: Your Years: 40
milestones.text: Forty: the body's skills come a little harder to learn now; crafts and words as readily as ever.

milestones.title: Your Years: 50
milestones.text: Seasoned: the crafts, healing and dealings you have practised are a level better for the years behind them.

milestones.title: Your Years: 55
milestones.text: Your knees aren't what they were: climbing, swimming, diving, blades and stamina are a level down, and come harder now.

milestones.title: Your Years: 60
milestones.text: Sixty: hard work tells — sailing, felling, mining, hunting and the fields are a level down.

milestones.title: Your Years: 61
milestones.text: The years tell again: the body's skills are another level down.

milestones.title: Your Years: 65
milestones.text: Old bones learn slowly now; your mind still learns, if a little slower.

milestones.title: Your Years: 67
milestones.text: The years tell again: the body's skills are another level down.

milestones.title: Your Years: 68
milestones.text: Hard work tells again: sailing, felling, mining, hunting and the fields are another level down.

milestones.title: Your Years: 73
milestones.text: The years tell again: the body's skills are another level down.
